verdict.rationale: A runtime probe found a live llms.txt at phaser.io that indexes the examples library and points to a programmatic examples API (GET /api/v1/examples/{id}), so an agent has a machine-readable entry point. However, the docs subdomain returns 404 for llms.txt and for markdown versions of doc pages, and phaser.io blocks non-browser clients at the root, so agent access to the core concept docs is limited. Missing for 10: an llms.txt covering the main docs at docs.phaser.io, markdown or agent-readable versions of the docs pages, reliable non-browser access, and first-party documentation of the llms.txt offering.
